subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

1) VRU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2831e3836c0745972e71ae4115ecec83d7d03443e21dece617ae43009d905bd8.png] 

2) PKO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9900463ced0980045ef45b0fb5c63a08a4d44e41d193ab047be3f1895f0143fd.png] 

3) FAE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b52c3c647b4dfdbd7733f6bd2568c57731cea14b8932df9826d0b04f5edc6121.png] 

4) MHL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d0abb5da0695fd46024b33aeb86bda97005735b29a6647269e48da61a190c0a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**VRU**".
